title: 매진이야
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop dance-pop track featuring bright female vocals and heavy electronic production. The arrangement centers on a thick, distorted synth bass and a driving four-on-the-floor kick drum. High-frequency synth stabs and percussive woodblock-style hits provide rhythmic accents. The chorus features layered vocal harmonies and a prominent sawtooth lead synth melody. The tempo is 128 BPM in the key of G Major. A mechanical sound effect of a machine starting up transitions the verse into the pre-chorus. The bassline uses a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern during the verses, shifting to sustained root notes in the chorus.
